collection.title: Vauxhall Corsa Van 2006 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Corsa 2006 to 2014 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Corsa Van which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
